name: mirage
text: Status: the parlay maker is live with small limits, and the Settled parlays tile and 24 h results shipped. Parlay coverage is still thin (MK8): most RFQs can't be priced, and same-game pairs wait on a correlation model, so wins are rare so far. P/L (TR3/TR4) is logged but not fixed yet. Two wallet figures still disagree by about $72, so the tracker's all-time number can swing. I haven't started that fix. I only logged your idea of using Novig's ledger per game day as the single source. It's next. I'll message you when it ships.
